simple.summary: מִפְרָשׂ (miphrâs) means an expansion First listed occurrence: Ezek 27 7.

definitions.full: H4666. miphras [ מִפְרָשׂ ] noun [masculine] spreading out, things spread ; — suffix מִפְרָשֵׂךְ Ezek 27:7 thy spread (canvas, as sail, compare verb Isa 33:23 ); plural construct עָב מִפְרְשֵׂי Job 36:29 , so perhaps 37:16 ( for מִפְלְשֵׂי ).
